title: Two Contacts in Parallel (OR Logic)
story: Service call bell: A bell must ring if EITHER station A or station B presses their call button. Wire two contacts in parallel so either path conducts.
concept: Contacts wired in parallel form an OR branch. If any parallel branch conducts, power reaches the output. Wires sharing a connection node display a junction dot.

learn.title: Parallel = OR
learn.text: Parallel branches give electricity alternate routes. If either button conducts, power flows around the open button and rings the bell.

hints: Connect Rail L to both CALL_A and CALL_B.
Connect the right terminals of both CALL_A and CALL_B to the input of BELL.
Connect BELL's output to Rail R.
